aboutPage.title: AI-powered coding learning support
aboutPage.description: CodeNexus does not sell packaged courses. We provide an AI system that supports self-learning: suggesting paths, breaking down goals, tracking progress, and guiding your next move.

tags.supportOnly: Learning support only, not course selling
tags.aiGenerated: Learning content is AI-generated and goal-optimized
tags.goalTracking: Progress tracking tied to real goals

features.title: How CodeNexus supports your learning
items: Generate learning paths for career goals (Frontend, Backend, Fullstack...).
Split plans into chapter/lesson flow with quizzes and tasks for quick self-check.
Focus sessions help maintain consistent study rhythm.
Chat with mentor/AI to unblock issues during practice.

aiFirst.title: AI-First Support
aiFirst.description: Plans are personalized by goals, pace, and real availability for each learner.

goalDriven.title: Goal-Driven
goalDriven.description: Every recommendation maps to concrete outcomes: skills, projects, milestones, and deadlines.

reliable.title: Reliable & Transparent
reliable.description: Progress is measured from real activity data so you always know where you are and what to do next.

community.title: Community Support
community.description: Connect with learners, mentors, and support channels to solve blockers faster.

support.title: Support information
support.liveChat: In-app live chat support (08:00 - 22:00, Monday - Sunday)
support.response: Average email response time: 2 - 6 business hours
support.note: For faster support, include your registered email, issue time, and screenshots so the team can investigate quickly.

supportCenter.title: Quick support center
supportCenter.description: You can send support requests via notifications or in-app chat. For serious account issues, contact support email for priority handling.
